The VOC device class doesn't accept the unit of measurement used by awair (`ppb`), thus adding this device class to it, would be incorrect.

Ref: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor#available-device-classes

This is actually correct and not a bug.

../Frenck

Hi :)
maybe, it should be considered to add these unit of measurements to that device class, since they are valid for VOC:

https://www.pressac.com/insights/what-are-volatile-organic-compounds-vocs-and-why-should-you-be-monitoring-them/#:~:text=Because%20there%20are%20so%20many,parts%20per%20billion%20(ppb)).

> How can VOC levels be monitored?
Because there are so many types of VOCs, they are often grouped together and monitored as TVOCs (Total Volatile Organic Compounds). can be measured in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3) of air, milligrams per cubic meter (mg/m3), parts per million (ppm) or parts per billion (ppb)).

> maybe, it should be considered to add these unit of measurements to that device class, since they are valid for VOC

That is not possible as we can't provide conversions for those.
More in-depth discussions can be found in our architecture repository.

../Frenck

review_comments:
The `VOLATILE_ORGANIC_COMPOUNDS` device class cannot have this unit of measurement.

See: <https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/sensor#available-device-classes>

../Frenck

Hi, thanks for the hint.
So... "CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_BILLION" should probably one of these then?

DeviceClass | Unit| Description
-- | -- | --
SensorDeviceClass.CARBON_DIOXIDE | ppm | Concentration of carbon dioxide.
-- | -- | --
SensorDeviceClass.CARBON_MONOXIDE | ppm | Concentration of carbon monoxide.

or the ppm should be extended to ppb...
AND ppm as well as ppb are valid unit of measurements for volatile organic compounds:
https://www.pressac.com/insights/what-are-volatile-organic-compounds-vocs-and-why-should-you-be-monitoring-them/#:~:text=Because%20there%20are%20so%20many,parts%20per%20billion%20(ppb)).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26391061/216560237-24558719-8ac6-4ed8-9dfb-6a20e415479b.png)

> So... "CONCENTRATION_PARTS_PER_BILLION" should probably one of these then?

CO & CO2 are not the same as VOC.

We currently do not have a device class available for VOC sensors using the `ppm` or `ppb` units for their measurement. In those cases, we don't set a device class.

>  ppm as well as ppb are valid unit of measurements for volatile organic compounds:

Sure, but not for Home Assistant.

../Frenck
